contract.clip: In-place Manny shoulder roll for learned Alt roll

visible_skin_and_weapon_collision_during.evidence_boundary: The retained comparison shows rigid anatomical proxy shapes on the real Manny armature. Runtime gameplay captures are a separate validation.

selected_defect: The procedural forward roll rotates a generic symmetric tuck past the plane on the head before recovering.
source_cause: The existing pose rotates the full pelvis 360 degrees with sine-based limb tuck and a fixed 39 cm pelvis drop.
repair: Original Blender curves of timed asymmetric crouch and chin tuck, lead arm IK at assumed default travel, shoulder weight transfer and gradual heel recovery.
retained_failures: V1 let the head remain the lowest support at 48 to 52 percent.
V2 preserved head clearance but left about 56 cm of wrist drift.
V3 wrist release was abrupt, and Workbench failed during rendering with native ntdll.dll exception.
V4 Workbench failed with the same native exception. The saved scene was rendered in CPU Cycles.

Two scratch Unreal commandlets timed out waiting for the SDK-check subprocess while a build was active. The scoped UE_SKIP_UBT_SDK_SETUP run imported the package and passed the same root verification.
